entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: Information element that indicates the UE requests the network to restrict paging.

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Information element that contains the request type value set by the UE.

entities.name: Request type is NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Condition where the Request type in UE request type IE is set to 'NAS signalling connection release'.

entities.name: Request type is Rejection of paging
entities.description: Condition where the Request type in UE request type IE is set to 'Rejection of paging'.

entities.name: UE requests paging restriction
entities.description: Condition where the UE requests the network to restrict paging.

relations.description: The UE request type IE can have its Request type set to 'NAS signalling connection release'.
The UE request type IE can have its Request type set to 'Rejection of paging'.
If Request type is 'NAS signalling connection release' and UE requests paging restriction, the Paging restriction IE shall be included.
If Request type is 'Rejection of paging' and UE requests paging restriction, the Paging restriction IE shall be included.
If the UE requests the network to restrict paging, the Paging restriction IE shall be included.
